title: LoginInviteRequest
description: The input of login.invite: the person to invite, a principal of the company, and the administrator's reason, which the log keeps (step 43's README, revision R2). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that invites a login.

person.description: The person's address in the company, such as dsor://org_456/person/cfo_100. Loose on purpose: an address that names no person of the company is refused by the command's own check, after line ② has checked the company, as step 29 does for a proposal.

reason.description: Why, in the administrator's own words, for the people who read the log.
